original_test_intent: Set an approved manufacturing date on the intended FRU through the Wistron OEM in-band command and prove the decoded field and surrounding FRU area remain valid and attributable to the correct target.
original_method: Master specifies 0x30/0x24 with an Ethernet Interface Select placeholder but no date bytes or readback. Review keeps that text and requires the vendor schema to reconcile selector, FRU target and date encoding before execution.
manual_activity: Owner/vendor provides the exact 0x30/0x24 request layout, maps the interface selector to one FRU, approves the encoded date and defines area/checksum validation plus supported restore.
required_inputs: Ethernet Interface Select meaning and value
Raw FRU readback and checksum method
Original field/area backup and restore procedure
safety_requirements: Do not infer the selector or omit it
Do not treat date bytes as the whole request without vendor proof
Do not use sshpass or disable host-key verification
Capture raw FRU area and checksum before mutation
Validate complete request length and field ranges
Read back the actual FRU manufacturing-date field
Compare every unrelated byte/field and checksum
Do not rewrite a full FRU, reset BMC or retry automatically
agent_execution_scope: Verify BMC/firmware and OEM schema applicability
Resolve selector to the intended FRU
Capture and hash original FRU area
Encode the approved date using authoritative rules
Present complete payload and blast radius for confirmation
Read/decode the target FRU area and checksum
Restore only by the approved method
engineer_actions: Approve schema, selector, date, checksum behavior and restore
Authorize one write and any later restoration
Own inventory/NVRAM risk and final DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not fit until reconciled: it replaces the source's interface selector with unspecified date bytes, uses insecure access and suggests generic lan output that cannot verify a FRU manufacturing-date field.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only after vendor confirmation, use protected `ipmitool raw 0x30 0x24 <complete vendor-defined selector/date payload>` exactly as documented; never send either source or DeepSeek placeholder in isolation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 0x30/0x24 family, Ethernet Interface Select placeholder and 10/5 timing remain preserved; no target, encoding or payload order is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the firmware-matched OEM schema to bind selector and encoded date to a backed-up target FRU, perform one confirmed write, then validate decoded date, raw-area integrity, checksum and unrelated-field stability.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing date, target mapping, readback and recovery contract while explicitly retaining the source's selector wording.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Command completion or generic LAN output does not prove the manufacturing date was changed in the intended FRU or that its checksum and neighboring fields remain valid.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong selector or date layout can corrupt or misattribute inventory and may require a vendor-specific restore rather than a generic FRU rewrite.

project_override_considerations: An approved vendor tool may replace raw IPMI only if it targets the same FRU field, exposes the encoded value and area/checksum evidence, and records whether 0x30/0x24 remains unverified.
expected_evidence: Verified BMC, selector and FRU identity
Approved date and exact encoded request
Pre-write raw FRU area/hash/checksum and decoded inventory

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title requires a manufacturing-date write, but the only Master parameter is Ethernet Interface Select and Criteria require only no command error. DeepSeek substitutes date bytes without explaining the selector and proposes insecure access plus irrelevant verification. Review preserves the conflict and requires the authoritative composite payload.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The functional target is explicit and the conflict can be resolved by a firmware-matched vendor command schema and project parameters. Those are execution-readiness inputs; review can complete without guessing or running the write.

review_improvement: Connects the OEM selector, target FRU and date encoding to raw-area/checksum evidence and an exact recovery boundary, while rejecting transport success and generic LAN data as acceptance.
independent_technical_reasoning: FRU manufacturing time is encoded inventory data protected by area layout and checksum semantics. The source's selector placeholder and DeepSeek's date-only placeholder cannot both be assumed complete. A safe package must use one authoritative payload definition, prove the selector maps to the intended FRU, back up the raw area, and verify the decoded date plus all non-target bytes. This remains a confirmable project execution package rather than a reason to alter the Master source.
